q.songTitle: The Silver Tongued Devil and I
q.line: And I sat me down by a tender young maiden
stanza: The song embodies the contemplative value of youth and the mistakes made in the…
We find that the ‘Silver… I took myself down to the Tally Ho Tavern
To buy me a bottle of beer
And I sat me down by a tender young maiden
Who's eyes were as dark as her hair
And as I was searching from bottle to bottle
That silver tongued devil just slipped from the shadows
